Text_ClairIsOut:
I am sorry.

CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, entered

the DRAGON'S DEN
behind the GYM.

I have no idea
when our LEADER will return.
Text_ClairIsIn:
CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, is waiting for you.

However, it would
be impossible for

a run-of-the-mill
trainer to win.
Text_ClairIsBeaten:
You defeated
CLAIR?

That's amazing!

I've never heard
of her losing to

anyone other than
LANCE.
BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText:
No. Only chosen
trainers may train

here.
Please leave.
BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText:
If CLAIR allows
it, her grand- father--our MASTER --will also.

You may enter.
BlackBeltText_WeirdRadio:
My radio's busted?
Lately, I only get this weird signal.
BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead:
Arooo! Voices in
my head!

Huh? I'm listening
to my radio!
BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text:
Are you going to
make your #MON forget some moves?
BlackthornYoungsterText:
Dragon masters all
come from the city of BLACKTHORN.
MeetSantosText:
SANTOS: …

It's Saturday…

I'm SANTOS of
Saturday…
SantosGaveGiftText:
SANTOS: …

SPELL TAG…

Ghost-type moves
get stronger…

It will frighten
you…
SantosSaturdayText:
SANTOS: …

See you again on
another Saturday…

I won't have any
more gifts…
BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text:
Wow, you came
through the ICE PATH?

You must be a real
hotshot trainer!
BlackthornCitySignText:

A Quiet Mountain
Retreat
BlackthornGymSignText:
BLACKTHORN CITY

a MIRACLEBERRY
